solver_settings.equation: steady incompressible Navier-Stokes: -nu lap(u) + (u.grad)u + grad p = 0, div u = 0
solver_settings.nonlinear_solver: Newton with analytic Jacobian, Stokes initial guess, backtracking, viscosity continuation ladder 8-4-2-1
solver_settings.pressure_gauge: zero mean pressure via Lagrange multiplier
solver_settings.reynolds_convention: Re = U L / nu with peak drive speed U = 1 (normalized) and reference length L = 1, so nu = 1/Re; the loader exposes viscosity = 1/Re as the global operator scalar
